dialogue: What can I do for you?
The 4am message. Yes. I have had three calls about it this morning. The polling station opens at 7am. It has always opened at 7am.
If you see the notice,  the EC logo on the real notices has the Sinha on the left and the date in a specific format on the footer. This one had neither. A detail, but details are the point.

options.text: I also saw campaign posters pasted on the Grama Sevaka Office wall.
options.consequence: 'Within 100 metres of a government building. That is a violation. I will have someone check it today.'
You leave, realizing how fast the message you forwarded has spread.
